name: Solvent drip tray
tech: ShapeItUp / replicad (TypeScript), PrusaSlicer, Prusament PETG, Prusa MK4IS
desc: Magnet-mounted PETG drip tray for oil-washing miniatures, built around a 6in steel cake pan.
details: Five magnets in the underside stick the tray to a steel bench; six more in the floor hold a steel pan that drops inside. Minis dry on the pan and the walls catch whatever runs off.
The front wall is cut down to an 8mm lip so a hand can reach in to paint without lifting anything out.

The pan has to be magnetic, which rules out aluminium, foil and most 18/10 "stainless" bakeware. Settled on a TeamFar 6in square pan in 18/0 stainless: 158.75mm outside, but the flat bottom is only 139.7mm, so the floor magnets have to sit inside that.
Every wall is a whole multiple of the 0.45mm extrusion width and every floor is 0.2 + n × 0.15mm, so the slicer never falls back to gap fill (which is where a 100%-infill part still leaks solvent).
Rebuilt as a parametric model after the first version, a PrusaSlicer primitive mashup, came out with floating walls and needed supports.

name: StreamStartQuality
tech: TypeScript, Vencord plugin API, Discord's internal Flux dispatcher
desc: Makes Discord screenshares start at full quality instead of slowly ramping up from a blurry first few seconds.
details: Discord's adaptive bitrate starts a new stream near zero and climbs, so viewers see mush for the first stretch of every screenshare.

The plugin listens for STREAM_CREATE on your own streams, waits a configurable delay (default 1500ms), then re-applies the current quality through Discord's own updateVideoQuality action. That triggers a fresh WebRTC offer at the full target bitrate.
Discord's streaming modules are lazy-loaded and only appear in the webpack cache after you've streamed once in a session, which made finding the right internal function the fiddly part.

name: matilyn.moe
desc: This site. A 2000s-portal layout designed at 1024px and scaled proportionally for modern screens.
details: Every size is written in "1024-era pixels" and scales with the window up to 2×, while borders stay a real 1px so they stay crisp.
Below 1024px it stops scaling and reflows instead: two columns on tablets, one on phones, with swipeable nav tabs.
Project lists, updates and links are JSON data files, so adding an entry updates every page that shows it.
